cohort: Multigravida women with at least three antenatal check-ups at a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India
finding: Short inter-delivery intervals are associated with increased risk of preterm delivery, maternal anemia, PPH, and scar rupture in post-cesarean pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was observed in 24% of the mothers.
birth_weight: Normal and low birth weight mentioned
